events.title: Class action lawsuit alleges Graphic Packaging misled investors
events.body: The lawsuit, which also names former GPI CEO Mike Doss and former CFO Stephen Scherger as defendants, claims shareholders endured harm from investment decisions based on misleading or withheld information.
